hushfacebook.title: v0.17.0
hushfacebook.body:
Hushfacebook moves to Facebook 584 and Morphe's new 2.0 patcher, so update Morphe Manager to 2.0.0 or newer before you patch. It's 64-bit only for now, since Facebook hasn't put out a 32-bit 584 yet. New switches can close Facebook when you leave it, hide the video comment box and draw thin lines between posts on the black theme, and a new patch keeps feed videos muted. Black cards buttons, the comment gestures in clean mode and Menu promotions in the side panel work again too.

New in this release

- New switch under Privacy, `Close Facebook when you leave it`. Three seconds after you leave Facebook it closes all the way and drops out of your recent apps, so nothing of it keeps running in the background (issue #202, requested by @M7amma). It holds off while an upload, a call or a Hushfacebook save is still going, or while a file picker or camera Facebook opened is on screen, and turning the screen off with Facebook in front doesn't count as leaving. Notifications can come late, or not until you open Facebook again. It starts off. Checked on a phone.

- New switch under Comments, `Hide the video comment box`. The Add a comment box under a full-screen video goes away, outline and all, while comment boxes on posts stay (issue #213, from a patch by @dijitalcozum). The Comment button beside the video still opens the comments, with their own box. It starts off. Checked on a phone.

- New switch under Appearance with the AMOLED black theme, `Lines between posts`. Facebook leaves a thin gap between posts that shows the page behind them, and on a black page that gap went black too, so a post without a photo ran straight into the next one (issue #206). With the switch on, that gap shows as a thin dark gray line in Facebook's dark mode, while the page and the cards stay black. It starts off. Checked on a phone, with the switch on and off.

- New patch, `Keep feed videos muted`, under Playback. Videos in the feed start with the sound off every time you open Facebook, even after you've been away a while, and Facebook doesn't turn it back on by itself. A video you open from the feed starts muted too. A tap on a video's speaker or the volume up key still turns it on. It starts off, and takes effect after the restart its switch offers. Checked on a phone.

Fixes

- With `Black cards` on, buttons like Log out in the side panel and Edit profile keep their dark gray fill again. In 0.16.0 and 0.16.1 the AMOLED theme's sweep for leftover dark colors also caught Hushfacebook's own colors, so those buttons went black on a black page and only their text showed (issue #191). Checked on a phone.

- `Open comments with a gesture` works with `Always use clean mode` on. Clean mode hides a reel's sidebar, Comment button and all, and the gestures pressed that button, so a long press fell back to Facebook's menu and a double tap did nothing (issue #179). A reel without the button now gets its comments from what its long-press handler keeps, on the same sheet the button opens. Checked on a phone, long press and double tap both.

- With `Leave calls and chats to Messenger` on, a message sent to you in Facebook's own Chats no longer shows up twice, once from Messenger and once from Facebook. Those messages reach your phone as Facebook's regular notifications rather than through its chat notifier, so they slipped past the switch. Facebook now leaves them to Messenger as well, while every other notification posts as before (issue #193). Checked in tests, not yet on a phone.

- `Hide Menu promotions` now holds in the side panel Menu for accounts Facebook gives its server-drawn Menu. 0.16.0 put Facebook's own Menu in that panel, but the Menu page inside it asks Facebook's server the same question again, and those accounts got the server's Menu right back with Upgrades and Also from Meta still in it (issue #184). Hushfacebook answers that second question too now. While any Menu switch is on, the panel and the Menu tab both show Facebook's own Menu with your hidden sections and shortcuts gone. Checked on a phone with Facebook's answer forced to the server-drawn Menu.

- `Block Instant Games ads` now covers games that open inside Facebook's main screen too. Those games talk to Facebook through a bridge of their own, so their ad requests went around the patch and some showed ads between levels anyway (issue #168). They get the same no-ad answer now, and with `Answer rewarded game ads as watched` on, a rewarded video still counts as watched. Checked on a phone with a game played to its map.

- `Disable Audience Network` stays off now. Facebook switched those parts back on after an install or update, and one of its startup tasks lets the server turn three of them on again (issue #168). Both are held off, and any an earlier install left on go back off when Facebook starts. Checked on a phone.

Other changes

- Hushfacebook now targets Facebook 584.0.0.51.56 only, the newest stable release. That's build 475817393 for 64-bit phones (the arm64-v8a 480dpi Android 11+ bundle). Facebook hasn't released a 32-bit build of 584 yet, so none is declared for now. If you're on 583.0.0.39.55, update Facebook to 584 before you patch.

- You need Morphe Manager 2.0.0 or newer now. The patches are built on Morphe's new 2.0 patcher, which Manager 1.x can't load (it asks you to update instead), so update Manager first. Desktop patching needs morphe-desktop 1.19.0 or newer for the same reason.

- The description of `Hide the reaction preview on posts` now says where the number on the Like button goes. That count belongs to `Hide counts on posts`, so the preview switch alone leaves it showing (issue #158).

- A settings file can now be up to 96 KB, up from 88 KB, so a file with every list full still fits now that there are more switches.

Behind the scenes

- The device audit can now put back the switches from a backup an older Hushfacebook build left on the phone. Switches added after that build weren't in the backup, so they kept the audit's all-on values, the restore never matched, and the audit folder stayed behind. Those switches go back to their defaults first now, and everything else comes from the backup. Checked on a phone.

- The device audit gets its report and opens the settings pages even when the walk ends on a reel or another full-screen page, and the phone smoke walk reaches the settings there too. Android dropped those requests without saying so, and the audit stopped with no report. The audit was checked on a phone, the smoke walk by its tests.

- The device audit no longer stops halfway when another tool reads the phone's lease file at the same moment. It waits a few seconds and tries again. A missing lease or one held by someone else still stops it.

- A baseline the device audit writes on Windows now has the same line endings as the copy in the repo, so promoting one doesn't leave the file looking half changed.

- No release goes out now until the whole app has been walked, on a phone or an emulator, with the exact bundle being published. `scripts/device-audit.ps1` leaves a `walk-receipt.json` saying how the walk ended, where it ran and which patch build the app reported, and the release script's publish step takes it as `-Walk`. Anything short of a full pass with no crash on that same bundle stops it before the tag.

- A release now also waits on Android's own code check, run on a phone or an emulator. The 0.16.0 comment crash was a method that phones refuse to load, and only the phone half of `scripts/verify-injected-registers.ps1` would have caught it, but the release check ran without a phone. With `-Serial` and `-ReceiptPath` it now leaves a `verifier-receipt.json` that names the phone, the patch build read out of the checked APK, and every message where the patched app and Meta's own build differ. The publish step takes it as `-Verifier` and stops before the tag unless it's a pass for that same bundle with no differences. When it stops, it names the methods that failed.

- The device patch scripts read morphe-desktop 1.19.0's results. That CLI renamed its list of patching steps, so every device patch read an empty list and counted as failed. Both names work now, and a result with no steps or a failed one is still refused.

- The source ledger asks an adopted source for proof on every Facebook build the patches declare, and on two builds whenever two are declared. With 584 out for 64-bit phones only, two fixtures of one declared build couldn't exist, so the old rule stopped every release.

The [changelog](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/Hushfacebook/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md) has every earlier release too.

How to update

1. Update Morphe Manager to 2.0.0 or newer, then refresh the Hushfacebook source.
2. Patch Facebook `584.0.0.51.56`. On most phones that's build `475817393`, the arm64-v8a one.
3. Install over your current patched Facebook with the manager's existing signing key. Keep that key so updates keep working.

The `.mpp` download is a patch bundle, not a Facebook APK. [Installation instructions](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/Hushfacebook#install).

Look over a diagnostic report before you share it. The filter can still miss private text it doesn't recognize.

What was checked

Local checks passed: 3483 runtime tests and 1119 patch tests with no failures, plus both Android lints and the release-script checks. All 95 patches applied without forcing to Facebook 584.0.0.51.56, the 64-bit build (Facebook hasn't released a 32-bit 584 yet), and a second build of the same commit matched this bundle entry for entry. I patched Facebook with this exact bundle and walked the whole app with every switch on, on an emulator signed in to a full account: 69 of 96 hook families ran, all 23 settings pages opened in dark and in light, and Facebook didn't crash once. Holding a reel opens its comments with every switch on, so a second short walk with that switch off reached Facebook's long-press menu, and Hold a reel for 2x, Share sheet items and Sanitize sharing links all ran there. Android's verifier raised nothing on the patched build, the same as on Meta's own. The walk doesn't reach downloads, chats or stories, so those are covered by the patch tests alone this time.

repos.body:
Hushfacebook moves to Facebook 584 and Morphe's new 2.0 patcher, so update Morphe Manager to 2.0.0 or newer before you patch. It's 64-bit only for now, since Facebook hasn't put out a 32-bit 584 yet. New switches can close Facebook when you leave it, hide the video comment box and draw thin lines between posts on the black theme, and a new patch keeps feed videos muted. Black cards buttons, the comment gestures in clean mode and Menu promotions in the side panel work again too.

New in this release

- New switch under Privacy, `Close Facebook when you leave it`. Three seconds after you leave Facebook it closes all the way and drops out of your recent apps, so nothing of it keeps running in the background (issue #202, requested by @M7amma). It holds off while an upload, a call or a Hushfacebook save is still going, or while a file picker or camera Facebook opened is on screen, and turning the screen off with Facebook in front doesn't count as leaving. Notifications can come late, or not until you open Facebook again. It starts off. Checked on a phone.

- New switch under Comments, `Hide the video comment box`. The Add a comment box under a full-screen video goes away, outline and all, while comment boxes on posts stay (issue #213, from a patch by @dijitalcozum). The Comment button beside the video still opens the comments, with their own box. It starts off. Checked on a phone.

- New switch under Appearance with the AMOLED black theme, `Lines between posts`. Facebook leaves a thin gap between posts that shows the page behind them, and on a black page that gap went black too, so a post without a photo ran straight into the next one (issue #206). With the switch on, that gap shows as a thin dark gray line in Facebook's dark mode, while the page and the cards stay black. It starts off. Checked on a phone, with the switch on and off.

- New patch, `Keep feed videos muted`, under Playback. Videos in the feed start with the sound off every time you open Facebook, even after you've been away a while, and Facebook doesn't turn it back on by itself. A video you open from the feed starts muted too. A tap on a video's speaker or the volume up key still turns it on. It starts off, and takes effect after the restart its switch offers. Checked on a phone.

Fixes

- With `Black cards` on, buttons like Log out in the side panel and Edit profile keep their dark gray fill again. In 0.16.0 and 0.16.1 the AMOLED theme's sweep for leftover dark colors also caught Hushfacebook's own colors, so those buttons went black on a black page and only their text showed (issue #191). Checked on a phone.

- `Open comments with a gesture` works with `Always use clean mode` on. Clean mode hides a reel's sidebar, Comment button and all, and the gestures pressed that button, so a long press fell back to Facebook's menu and a double tap did nothing (issue #179). A reel without the button now gets its comments from what its long-press handler keeps, on the same sheet the button opens. Checked on a phone, long press and double tap both.

- With `Leave calls and chats to Messenger` on, a message sent to you in Facebook's own Chats no longer shows up twice, once from Messenger and once from Facebook. Those messages reach your phone as Facebook's regular notifications rather than through its chat notifier, so they slipped past the switch. Facebook now leaves them to Messenger as well, while every other notification posts as before (issue #193). Checked in tests, not yet on a phone.

- `Hide Menu promotions` now holds in the side panel Menu for accounts Facebook gives its server-drawn Menu. 0.16.0 put Facebook's own Menu in that panel, but the Menu page inside it asks Facebook's server the same question again, and those accounts got the server's Menu right back with Upgrades and Also from Meta still in it (issue #184). Hushfacebook answers that second question too now. While any Menu switch is on, the panel and the Menu tab both show Facebook's own Menu with your hidden sections and shortcuts gone. Checked on a phone with Facebook's answer forced to the server-drawn Menu.

- `Block Instant Games ads` now covers games that open inside Facebook's main screen too. Those games talk to Facebook through a bridge of their own, so their ad requests went around the patch and some showed ads between levels anyway (issue #168). They get the same no-ad answer now, and with `Answer rewarded game ads as watched` on, a rewarded video still counts as watched. Checked on a phone with a game played to its map.

- `Disable Audience Network` stays off now. Facebook switched those parts back on after an install or update, and one of its startup tasks lets the server turn three of them on again (issue #168). Both are held off, and any an earlier install left on go back off when Facebook starts. Checked on a phone.

Other changes

- Hushfacebook now targets Facebook 584.0.0.51.56 only, the newest stable release. That's build 475817393 for 64-bit phones (the arm64-v8a 480dpi Android 11+ bundle). Facebook hasn't released a 32-bit build of 584 yet, so none is declared for now. If you're on 583.0.0.39.55, update Facebook to 584 before you patch.

- You need Morphe Manager 2.0.0 or newer now. The patches are built on Morphe's new 2.0 patcher, which Manager 1.x can't load (it asks you to update instead), so update Manager first. Desktop patching needs morphe-desktop 1.19.0 or newer for the same reason.

- The description of `Hide the reaction preview on posts` now says where the number on the Like button goes. That count belongs to `Hide counts on posts`, so the preview switch alone leaves it showing (issue #158).

- A settings file can now be up to 96 KB, up from 88 KB, so a file with every list full still fits now that there are more switches.

Behind the scenes

- The device audit can now put back the switches from a backup an older Hushfacebook build left on the phone. Switches added after that build weren't in the backup, so they kept the audit's all-on values, the restore never matched, and the audit folder stayed behind. Those switches go back to their defaults first now, and everything else comes from the backup. Checked on a phone.

- The device audit gets its report and opens the settings pages even when the walk ends on a reel or another full-screen page, and the phone smoke walk reaches the settings there too. Android dropped those requests without saying so, and the audit stopped with no report. The audit was checked on a phone, the smoke walk by its tests.

- The device audit no longer stops halfway when another tool reads the phone's lease file at the same moment. It waits a few seconds and tries again. A missing lease or one held by someone else still stops it.

- A baseline the device audit writes on Windows now has the same line endings as the copy in the repo, so promoting one doesn't leave the file looking half changed.

- No release goes out now until the whole app has been walked, on a phone or an emulator, with the exact bundle being published. `scripts/device-audit.ps1` leaves a `walk-receipt.json` saying how the walk ended, where it ran and which patch build the app reported, and the release script's publish step takes it as `-Walk`. Anything short of a full pass with no crash on that same bundle stops it before the tag.

- A release now also waits on Android's own code check, run on a phone or an emulator. The 0.16.0 comment crash was a method that phones refuse to load, and only the phone half of `scripts/verify-injected-registers.ps1` would have caught it, but the release check ran without a phone. With `-Serial` and `-ReceiptPath` it now leaves a `verifier-receipt.json` that names the phone, the patch build read out of the checked APK, and every message where the patched app and Meta's own build differ. The publish step takes it as `-Verifier` and stops before the tag unless it's a pass for that same bundle with no differences. When it stops, it names the methods that failed.

- The device patch scripts read morphe-desktop 1.19.0's results. That CLI renamed its list of patching steps, so every device patch read an empty list and counted as failed. Both names work now, and a result with no steps or a failed one is still refused.

- The source ledger asks an adopted source for proof on every Facebook build the patches declare, and on two builds whenever two are declared. With 584 out for 64-bit phones only, two fixtures of one declared build couldn't exist, so the old rule stopped every release.

The [changelog](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/Hushfacebook/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md) has every earlier release too.

How to update

1. Update Morphe Manager to 2.0.0 or newer, then refresh the Hushfacebook source.
2. Patch Facebook `584.0.0.51.56`. On most phones that's build `475817393`, the arm64-v8a one.
3. Install over your current patched Facebook with the manager's existing signing key. Keep that key so updates keep working.

The `.mpp` download is a patch bundle, not a Facebook APK. [Installation instructions](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/Hushfacebook#install).

Look over a diagnostic report before you share it. The filter can still miss private text it doesn't recognize.

What was checked

Local checks passed: 3483 runtime tests and 1119 patch tests with no failures, plus both Android lints and the release-script checks. All 95 patches applied without forcing to Facebook 584.0.0.51.56, the 64-bit build (Facebook hasn't released a 32-bit 584 yet), and a second build of the same commit matched this bundle entry for entry. I patched Facebook with this exact bundle and walked the whole app with every switch on, on an emulator signed in to a full account: 69 of 96 hook families ran, all 23 settings pages opened in dark and in light, and Facebook didn't crash once. Holding a reel opens its comments with every switch on, so a second short walk with that switch off reached Facebook's long-press menu, and Hold a reel for 2x, Share sheet items and Sanitize sharing links all ran there. Android's verifier raised nothing on the patched build, the same as on Meta's own. The walk doesn't reach downloads, chats or stories, so those are covered by the patch tests alone this time.

hushmessenger.title: v0.26.0
hushmessenger.body:
### Reported issues

- [#69](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushMessenger/issues/69) New **Quiet incoming calls** switch under Conversations. Calls still come in, but Messenger doesn't ring, vibrate or pop the call up over what you're doing. The call waits in the notification shade with its Answer and Decline buttons, and a call you miss still shows up in the chat. If the Facebook app is on your phone, it can still ring for the same call. It starts off.
- [#81](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushMessenger/issues/81) New **Hide tab badges** switch under Navigation. It clears the red dots and counts from the tabs at the bottom and from the Facebook button at the top. Want one of them back, say the Chats count? Turn on its Keep switch right below. Restart Messenger after a change. It's off until you turn it on.
- [#85](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushMessenger/issues/85) New **Hide the recent photo card** switch under Photos and videos. Take a screenshot or a photo and Messenger puts a card above the message box offering to send it. With this on, the card doesn't show up. Anything you took is still in the gallery button when you want to send it. It starts off.
- [#64](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushMessenger/issues/64) With two gallery apps on the phone and neither set as the default, **Open your gallery app** sent you to a Samsung Gallery that listed photos only. Videos show up there now too, and Android's list of apps to pick from still holds just your galleries.
- [#64](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushMessenger/issues/64) and [#82](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushMessenger/issues/82) **Open your gallery app** lets you pick several photos and videos at once. Pick two or more and Messenger's Send to sheet opens with all of them and the chat you came from at the top, so one Send gets them there. Pick just one and it opens in Messenger's editor like before. Samsung's Gallery now asks for a tap on Done even when you pick a single photo.
- [#80](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushMessenger/issues/80) **Stop analytics uploads** now also stops the upload Messenger 584 starts from inside the app. On 584 Messenger can send its analytics batch, the one that holds the tap and scroll details from the report, without going through the background upload services the switch already stopped. With the switch on, that one doesn't start either.
- [#79](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushMessenger/issues/79) An auto reply can send a picture too. Open a reply under **Auto reply** and tap **Add a picture**. The text goes out first and the picture follows a couple of seconds later in the same chat, with the same once-per-chat wait, Off and Pause as the text. HushMessenger keeps its own copy of the picture, so moving or deleting the original won't break the reply. If that copy is gone, or a Messenger update changed how photos are sent, the text still goes out on its own.

### Changed and fixed

- HushMessenger now patches Messenger 584.0.0.49.98 (version code 346814894) and no longer takes 583.0.0.29.95. That's the one arm64 build of 584 on [APKMirror](https://www.apkmirror.com/apk/facebook-2/messenger/facebook-messenger-584-0-0-49-98-release/) so far. Every switch was checked against it again, so update Messenger to 584 before you repatch.
- **Hide inbox ads** is gone. Meta stopped selling Messenger inbox ads in November 2025, and Messenger 584 took out the ad cards the switch used to filter, so there's nothing left for it to hide. If you pick patches by hand in Morphe, it just won't be in the list anymore.
- The six photo and video switches now have their own **Photos and videos** group, in Morphe's patch list and on the settings Controls tab alike: original quality photos and videos, **Fix videos that won't send**, the camera and gallery app switches, and **Hide the recent photo card**. Conversations had grown too long to scan. The Chats filter still shows them.
- **Patch controls** and **Restart Messenger** now stay at the top of the icon's long-press menu while Messenger sits in the background. New messages used to push them below the four rows your launcher shows until you next opened and left Messenger. Android 9 and 10 still put them back only when Messenger opens or closes.
- Hiding Quick setups with a long press now names the button that brings it back, **Quick setups section** under Your choices. The old message sent you to the App tab you were already on, and the button talked about a home page that doesn't exist.
- A video picked in a chat whose access ran out before or during the send no longer gets **Fix videos that won't send** marked as failing in settings. It goes out the way Messenger would send it anyway.
- If the phone's sound encoder won't start while a video's sound is being fixed, it's let go right away instead of staying held until Messenger closes.
- The copies **Fix videos that won't send** makes of videos you pick now go a day after their last use, even if you never pick another video or you've turned the switch off. Messenger clears them when it starts and again while it's open as each one's day runs out. They used to sit in Messenger's cache until the next pick.
- Android 12 and newer show only two lines of a pop-up message and cut the rest with "...", which hid the useful part of 27 of HushMessenger's. They're shorter now and fit, from the font file and backup messages to the camera, gallery and restart ones.
- Restoring your choices pops up how many of them it actually changed ("Changed 3 of 58 choices"), that none changed, or that they already match the backup, plus "Changes paused" or "Changes resumed" when the backup pauses or unpauses them. It used to count every choice in the backup, even ones that were already set that way, and the pause along with them. It only says they match when nothing in the backup was skipped or left off. Skipped choices and Auto reply staying off used to run past the end of that message. Now the whole result stays written under the backup buttons.
- When reading a choices file takes too long, the message says your choices didn't change. It used to warn that a saved file may be cut off, which is only true when saving one.
- If settings can't open from the side menu or the Messenger logo, two short messages now say so and then name the other way in. One message was too long and lost its second half.
- Picking a font file while **Use your own font** is off now says to turn the switch on, instead of telling you to restart Messenger. The file's name stays on the line under the button, where a long one can't push the rest off the message.
- **Use system emoji** loads the phone's emoji font once, even when Messenger asks for it from several threads at the same moment. Each thread could load its own copy before.
- When the message log can't save new messages (the phone's key store is busy, say), it tries again by itself 30 seconds later, then less often while it keeps failing. Those messages used to wait for the next notification and were lost if Messenger closed first.
- **Back to defaults**, the other Quick setups and **Clear log** each show an Undo button at the top of settings for about 10 seconds, and the emptied log shows one too. Clear log still deletes the saved messages and their key right away. Undo writes them back from a copy kept in memory until the button goes, and leaving settings makes the change final. Undo leaves alone any switch you flipped yourself after the change.
- The **Patch controls** and **Restart Messenger** long-press shortcuts now tell your launcher when you use them, so it can rank them by use the way it does Messenger's own chat shortcuts.
- On a Root Mount install, **Patch controls** and **Restart Messenger** never actually showed up on Messenger's icon. Android turned down the icons they used. They show up now.
- Each way back into settings now has its own switch on the App tab, as asked in [HushFacebook#146](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushFacebook/issues/146). Next to **Hide the Menu row** there's **Hide the icon shortcuts**, which takes **Patch controls** and **Restart Messenger** off the menu you get by long-pressing Messenger's home screen icon, and **Ignore the logo long press**. The last way in that's still on can't be switched off: its switch goes gray and says why, and if a saved choice leaves nothing else, the icon shortcuts come back by themselves. Pause and safe mode leave these switches alone, since they're how you get back in to undo either. If the logo long press is what lets the Menu row stay hidden, the row comes back after an update or a repatch until one long press on the logo opens settings again.
- The two icon shortcuts now come from HushMessenger each time Messenger starts, on every install, which is what lets the new switch take them away. After updating, they show up again a moment after you first open Messenger. Messenger's own chat shortcuts can push them down that menu while it's open, so they move back to the top each time you leave Messenger. On a normal install, a copy you pinned to the home screen before this update stops working, so remove it and pin a new one. Copies pinned from now on turn gray while the shortcuts are hidden and work again once they're back.
- When Messenger's chat shortcuts already fill everything Android lets one icon hold, the lowest of them now make room, so **Patch controls** and **Restart Messenger** still get on. Android refused to add them to a full icon before. Those are the same chat shortcuts Android drops when Messenger adds one to a full icon itself.
- In the settings cards, the line between switches now sits below a switch's own buttons (Keep the Profile button, the bubble choices, the font file, message log and auto reply buttons) instead of between the switch and them. The last switch in a card no longer draws a second line just above the card's edge.
- With a keyboard or a remote, the focus outline on a filled settings button (Restart Messenger, Save, the selected tab and filter) is now two rings, a dark and a light one, so it shows up against the button and the page in both themes. The single gray ring was hard to see on the button's own color.
- The settings call each thing by one name now. Controls are the switches, and your choices are what you set them to. The clipboard backup buttons are **Copy choices** and **Paste choices**, since Export and Import sat right next to the file buttons and sounded like them. The third bubble mode is **Android bubbles**, which is what Android calls them. Flipping a control pops up "Hide stories and notes is on" instead of "Hide stories and notes on", and **Fix videos that won't send** says what it does before it names the sound format.
- Two patches got plainer names, in Morphe's patch list and in settings. **Turn off the swipe up for disappearing messages** is now **Ignore the swipe up for disappearing messages**, and **Stop MQTT logging** is now **Stop live connection logging**. Morphe remembers your picks by name, so if you'd left either one out, it'll be picked again. Uncheck it before you repatch.
- With **Hide People tab**, **Hide Notifications tab** or **Hide Meta AI** on, the bar at the bottom now lights up the tab you're actually on. With People hidden, opening Notifications used to light up Menu instead.
- Some accounts get Meta's newer AI agent tab in the bar where the Meta AI tab usually sits. **Hide Meta AI** now hides that one too, and the bar still lights up the right tab. Restart Messenger to see it go.
- On a new install of a patched Messenger, **Bold** and **Italic** no longer show up in the text selection menu while **Bold and italic text** is off. Messenger's very first start turned them on, and they stayed there until you opened Messenger a second time. Updating over an existing install never did this.
- **Hide AI sticker tools** now hides the plain **Generate** button at the start of the sticker keyboard's Suggested row too. Accounts that get more than one sticker maker see that button instead of **Generate AI stickers**, and it opens a menu with AI stickers in it, so the switch used to miss it. The custom and music stickers in that menu are hidden along with it while the switch is on.
- With **Hide AI sticker tools** on, the rest of the Suggested row now moves up to fill the spot where **Generate** or **Generate AI stickers** used to sit. The button went away before, but its slot at the start of the row stayed blank.
- HushMessenger is now built for Morphe's 2.0 patcher, so this release needs **Morphe Manager 2.0.0 or newer**. Update Manager first, then repatch. Every patch still applies to Messenger 584 and the patch count is the same.

### Docs

A record pins the APK's checksum, so a re-signed copy could have been written down as the stock build. The release build stage also checks each stock APK against the checksum in its record before patching it, and CompatReport looks for Python as `py`, `python3` or `python` (never the Windows Store stub) instead of assuming `python`.

### Reported issues

- [#69](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushMessenger/issues/69) New **Quiet incoming calls** switch under Conversations. Calls still come in, but Messenger doesn't ring, vibrate or pop the call up over what you're doing. The call waits in the notification shade with its Answer and Decline buttons, and a call you miss still shows up in the chat. - [#81](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushMessenger/issues/81) New **Hide tab badges** switch under Navigation. It clears the red dots and counts from the tabs at the bottom and from the Facebook button at the top. Want one of them back, say the Chats count? Turn on its Keep switch right below. Restart Messenger after a change. It's off until you turn it on.
- [#85](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushMessenger/issues/85) New **Hide the recent photo card** switch under Photos and videos. Take a screenshot or a photo and Messenger puts a card above the message box offering to send it. With this on, the card doesn't show up. Anything you took is still in the gallery button when you want to send it. It starts off.
- [#64](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushMessenger/issues/64) With two gallery apps on the phone and neither set as the default, **Open your gallery app** sent you to a Samsung Gallery that listed photos only. Videos show up there now too, and Android's list of apps to pick from still holds just your galleries.
- [#64](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushMessenger/issues/64) and [#82](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushMessenger/issues/82) **Open your gallery app** lets you pick several photos and videos at once. Pick two or more and Messenger's Send to sheet opens with all of them and the chat you came from at the top, so one Send gets them there. Pick just one and it opens in Messenger's editor like before. Samsung's Gallery now asks for a tap on Done even when you pick a single photo.
- [#80](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushMessenger/issues/80) **Stop analytics uploads** now also stops the upload Messenger 584 starts from inside the app. On 584 Messenger can send its analytics batch, the one that holds the tap and scroll details from the report, without going through the background upload services the switch already stopped. With the switch on, that one doesn't start either.
- [#79](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushMessenger/issues/79) An auto reply can send a picture too. Open a reply under **Auto reply** and tap **Add a picture**. The text goes out first and the picture follows a couple of seconds later in the same chat, with the same once-per-chat wait, Off and Pause as the text. HushMessenger keeps its own copy of the picture, so moving or deleting the original won't break the reply. If that copy is gone, or a Messenger update changed how photos are sent, the text still goes out on its own.

- HushMessenger now patches Messenger 584.0.0.49.98 (version code 346814894) and no longer takes 583.0.0.29.95. That's the one arm64 build of 584 on [APKMirror](https://www.apkmirror.com/apk/facebook-2/messenger/facebook-messenger-584-0-0-49-98-release/) so far. Every switch was checked against it again, so update Messenger to 584 before you repatch.
- **Hide inbox ads** is gone. Meta stopped selling Messenger inbox ads in November 2025, and Messenger 584 took out the ad cards the switch used to filter, so there's nothing left for it to hide. If you pick patches by hand in Morphe, it just won't be in the list anymore.
- The six photo and video switches now have their own **Photos and videos** group, in Morphe's patch list and on the settings Controls tab alike: original quality photos and videos, **Fix videos that won't send**, the camera and gallery app switches, and **Hide the recent photo card**. Conversations had grown too long to scan. The Chats filter still shows them.
- **Patch controls** and **Restart Messenger** now stay at the top of the icon's long-press menu while Messenger sits in the background. New messages used to push them below the four rows your launcher shows until you next opened and left Messenger. Android 9 and 10 still put them back only when Messenger opens or closes.
- Hiding Quick setups with a long press now names the button that brings it back, **Quick setups section** under Your choices. The old message sent you to the App tab you were already on, and the button talked about a home page that doesn't exist.
- A video picked in a chat whose access ran out before or during the send no longer gets **Fix videos that won't send** marked as failing in settings. It goes out the way Messenger would send it anyway.
- If the phone's sound encoder won't start while a video's sound is being fixed, it's let go right away instead of staying held until Messenger closes.
- The copies **Fix videos that won't send** makes of videos you pick now go a day after their last use, even if you never pick another video or you've turned the switch off. Skipped choices and Auto reply staying off used to run past the end of that message. Now the whole result stays written under the backup buttons.
- When reading a choices file takes too long, the message says your choices didn't change. It used to warn that a saved file may be cut off, which is only true when saving one.
- If settings can't open from the side menu or the Messenger logo, two short messages now say so and then name the other way in. One message was too long and lost its second half.
- Picking a font file while **Use your own font** is off now says to turn the switch on, instead of telling you to restart Messenger. The file's name stays on the line under the button, where a long one can't push the rest off the message.
- **Use system emoji** loads the phone's emoji font once, even when Messenger asks for it from several threads at the same moment. Each thread could load its own copy before.
- When the message log can't save new messages (the phone's key store is busy, say), it tries again by itself 30 seconds later, then less often while it keeps failing. Those messages used to wait for the next notification and were lost if Messenger closed first.

Undo leaves alone any switch you flipped yourself after the change.
- The **Patch controls** and **Restart Messenger** long-press shortcuts now tell your launcher when you use them, so it can rank them by use the way it does Messenger's own chat shortcuts.
- On a Root Mount install, **Patch controls** and **Restart Messenger** never actually showed up on Messenger's icon. Android turned down the icons they used. They show up now.
- Each way back into settings now has its own switch on the App tab, as asked in [HushFacebook#146](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushFacebook/issues/146). Next to **Hide the Menu row** there's **Hide the icon shortcuts**, which takes **Patch controls** and **Restart Messenger** off the menu you get by long-pressing Messenger's home screen icon, and **Ignore the logo long press**. The last way in that's still on can't be switched off: its switch goes gray and says why, and if a saved choice leaves nothing else, the icon shortcuts come back by themselves. Pause and safe mode leave these switches alone, since they're how you get back in to undo either. If the logo long press is what lets the Menu row stay hidden, the row comes back after an update or a repatch until one long press on the logo opens settings again.
- The two icon shortcuts now come from HushMessenger each time Messenger starts, on every install, which is what lets the new switch take them away. After updating, they show up again a moment after you first open Messenger. Messenger's own chat shortcuts can push them down that menu while it's open, so they move back to the top each time you leave Messenger. On a normal install, a copy you pinned to the home screen before this update stops working, so remove it and pin a new one. Copies pinned from now on turn gray while the shortcuts are hidden and work again once they're back.
- When Messenger's chat shortcuts already fill everything Android lets one icon hold, the lowest of them now make room, so **Patch controls** and **Restart Messenger** still get on. Android refused to add them to a full icon before. Those are the same chat shortcuts Android drops when Messenger adds one to a full icon itself.
- In the settings cards, the line between switches now sits below a switch's own buttons (Keep the Profile button, the bubble choices, the font file, message log and auto reply buttons) instead of between the switch and them. The last switch in a card no longer draws a second line just above the card's edge.
- With a keyboard or a remote, the focus outline on a filled settings button (Restart Messenger, Save, the selected tab and filter) is now two rings, a dark and a light one, so it shows up against the button and the page in both themes. - The settings call each thing by one name now. Controls are the switches, and your choices are what you set them to. The clipboard backup buttons are **Copy choices** and **Paste choices**, since Export and Import sat right next to the file buttons and sounded like them. The third bubble mode is **Android bubbles**, which is what Android calls them. Flipping a control pops up "Hide stories and notes is on" instead of "Hide stories and notes on", and **Fix videos that won't send** says what it does before it names the sound format.
- Two patches got plainer names, in Morphe's patch list and in settings. **Turn off the swipe up for disappearing messages** is now **Ignore the swipe up for disappearing messages**, and **Stop MQTT logging** is now **Stop live connection logging**. Morphe remembers your picks by name, so if you'd left either one out, it'll be picked again. Uncheck it before you repatch.
- With **Hide People tab**, **Hide Notifications tab** or **Hide Meta AI** on, the bar at the bottom now lights up the tab you're actually on. With People hidden, opening Notifications used to light up Menu instead.
- Some accounts get Meta's newer AI agent tab in the bar where the Meta AI tab usually sits. **Hide Meta AI** now hides that one too, and the bar still lights up the right tab. Restart Messenger to see it go.
- On a new install of a patched Messenger, **Bold** and **Italic** no longer show up in the text selection menu while **Bold and italic text** is off. Messenger's very first start turned them on, and they stayed there until you opened Messenger a second time. Updating over an existing install never did this.
- **Hide AI sticker tools** now hides the plain **Generate** button at the start of the sticker keyboard's Suggested row too. hushfeed.title: v0.78.0
hushfeed.body:
Hushfeed v0.78.0 has 138 patches for global TikTok 47.5.3 (`com.zhiliaoapp.musically`), and 90 of them work on PineDrama 47.4.3 too. It needs Morphe Manager 2.0.0 or newer, since it's built on patcher 2.0.0.

TikTok moves up to 47.5.3 and 47.4.3 is dropped, so grab the new APK before you patch. PineDrama stays on 47.4.3. Patching is quicker on Manager 2.0 and needs less memory. There are lots of new switches too, like double taps by corner, sorting for profile grids, a seek bar on sound previews and a glass lens for the tab bar.

Here's every report this release changed something for, and what changed.

For bug reports

* Video controls that wouldn't stay put (#209). `Keep faded controls in Clear display` keeps the like, comment, save and share buttons on screen again, and the diagnostic report no longer calls the controls broken on accounts without the Following stories button.
* Commenting in LIVE (#110). With `Log diagnostics` on, the report now says which LIVE room each comment went to, using short codes in place of room ids.
* The time beside the progress bar (#173). A new `Where the time goes` choice can put the time above the bar, and the caption and buttons move up to make room.

For feature requests

* OmerKurdi79's batch (#232). `Double tap by corner`, recent searches in Hushfeed's settings search and `Keep Clear display across videos` are in, adapted from their fork.
* Better sorting (#180). `Sort loaded videos on profile grids` sorts what a profile or Liked grid has loaded by date, length, views or likes.
* Slideshows that fit the screen (#188). `Fit the video to the screen` shows photo slideshows whole on squarer screens.
* Auto captions (#217). `Keep captions available` brings back the Captions switch TikTok hides for some accounts and regions.
* Time zone spoofing and more regions (#184, #198). `Match locale and timezone to country` makes that country's zone TikTok's own from the moment it starts.
* A seek bar for sounds (#185). `Seek bar on sound previews` lets you tap or drag through a sound's preview.
* Auto translation and Balance (#194). `Don't auto translate videos` keeps videos in their own language, and `Hide Balance in the profile menu` takes Balance out of that menu.
* Original image formats (#229). `Keep photos as TikTok sent them` saves the HEIF or WebP file as it came.
* A liquid glass tab bar (#231, #124). `Glass lens on the current tab` puts a small piece of glass behind the tab you're on.
* TikTok Minis (#230). `Hide the TikTok Minis icons in the profile menu` makes that menu shorter.
* The side menu swipe (#213). `Turn off the swipe to the side menu` stops a right swipe on For You from opening it.
* Inbox badge colors (#192). The unread count and dots now follow `Accent color` like the LIVE bubble does.
* Comments at full height (#191). `Open the comments at full height` opens the sheet all the way up.
* Camera brightness (#200). `Keep the screen's brightness in the camera` stops TikTok's camera from turning your screen up.
* A Watch history shortcut (#199). `Long-press Profile for Watch history` opens it from the Profile tab.
* LIVE recording quality (#203). `LIVE recording quality` can record the room's best stream or its smallest one.
* Fullscreen video behind the tabs (#145, #218). `See-through bottom bar` keeps the video behind the tabs as you swipe, and portrait videos now reach the bottom of the screen.
* Latest on Following (#226). `Latest first on Following` plays each batch of the Following feed newest first.
* The system font (#7). A Galaxy font picked in Android's settings now shows on TikTok's web pages too.
* Material You colors (#163). The "You may like" words on the search page take your accent color.
* Download features (#27). `Saves right now` shows the saves under way with a Cancel, and `Saves at once` sets how many run together.

## What's changed

* Hushfeed now supports TikTok 47.5.3 and drops 47.4.3. Grab the 47.5.3 APK from APKMirror and patch it with the same signing key, and your login and settings carry over. PineDrama stays on 47.4.3.
* `Remove unused language packs` now patches PineDrama 47.4.3 too. Its language files list the same 25 languages as TikTok's but word the list differently, and the patch stopped at that instead of trimming them.
* `Search loaded activity` puts its search bar back on the Inbox's Activity page. Since 0.77.0 the bar never showed up, because Hushfeed was still looking for TikTok's list under the names an older TikTok gave it.
* New `Double tap by corner` switch under `Double tap` in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen. Turn it on and each quarter of the video gets its own double tap choice, so the top left can open the comments while the bottom right keeps TikTok's like. Off, `Double tap` works like before. The idea and first version came from @OmerKurdi79 (#232).
* Settings search remembers what you looked for. With the box empty it lists your last ten searches, newest first. Tap one to run it again, tap the bin to forget it, or clear the list at the bottom. A search is kept once you press search on the keyboard, open one of its results or flip a switch it found, and the list stays out of backups (#232).
* New `Keep Clear display across videos` switch in the Clear display part of Hushfeed settings > Feed screen. It's on by default, which is how Clear display has carried over until now. Turn it off and a Clear display you turn on by hand lasts for that video only, so the next one starts with its buttons showing (#232).
* Patching is faster. Many patches used to search every class in TikTok for the code they change, and now they look it up by a string, a number or a name the patcher already keeps an index of. With every patch on 47.4.3, a desktop run went from 89 to 60 seconds and the patching step itself from 54 to 26. The APK that comes out is the same.
* `Sort loaded videos on profile grids` sorts the videos a profile or Liked grid has loaded. You can put the newest or oldest first, the longest or shortest, or the most viewed or most liked. Pinned videos stay first, videos with no value for that order go last, and new pages are sorted in as you scroll. `Original order` is TikTok's own. It only changes videos the grid has already loaded, not the ones it hasn't fetched yet (#180).
* `Fit the video to the screen` now shows photo slideshows whole on a squarer screen too. Each slide sits centered with black above and below instead of losing the top and bottom, and swiping, the dots, the caption and the music line work as before. On a normal tall phone nothing changes (#188).
* New `Keep captions available` switch under Hushfeed settings > Feed screen > Captions. TikTok hides the Captions switch in its accessibility settings, and the caption controls that go with it, for some accounts and regions. Turn this on and they come back. Captions still only show on videos that carry them. It's off by default and takes a TikTok restart to apply (#217).
* `Match locale and timezone to country` now makes that country's time zone TikTok's own from the moment it starts, daylight saving included. Before, only the zone TikTok reports changed. Hushfeed's own clocks (the daily limit's reset, the sleep timer and Auto streak's send time) stay on your phone's time (#184, #198).
* New `Seek bar on sound previews` switch under Hushfeed settings > Playback, part of `Show the progress bar`. When you play a sound's preview on its page, a line along the bottom of the cover shows how far in you are and how long the preview runs. Tap or drag it to jump around in the preview. The line goes away when the preview stops, and a sound that can't be skipped through keeps TikTok's own controls. It's off by default (#185).
* `Keep faded controls in Clear display` keeps the like, comment, save and share buttons on screen again. Newer TikTok builds hide the whole button column at once in Clear display instead of each button, so the buttons stayed away even with the switch on (#209).
* The diagnostic report no longer calls the video controls broken for accounts without the Following stories button. TikTok only shows that button to some accounts, and every Clear display without it got counted as a missing part (#209).

hushgram.title: v0.0.15
hushgram.body:
## [0.0.15](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushGram/compare/v0.0.14...v0.0.15) (2026-10-22)

### Features

* **Instagram:** New switch under Downloads, `Add the source to saved photos`, off to start. A saved JPEG photo carries the account that posted it, the post date and the post's link in its EXIF details. The picture doesn't change.
* **Instagram - Download any reel:** Reels on the Reels tab get Details and Copy caption in their menu now, the same as feed posts. (#282)

### Bug Fixes

* **Instagram - Hide Follow on feed posts:** The Subscribe button next to a creator's name on feed posts goes too now. On Reels it goes with Clean up Reels' follow switch. A creator's own profile keeps its button. (#248)
* **Instagram - Clean up Reels:** With `Keep clear mode on`, a long reel in clear mode no longer keeps its seek bar along the bottom. The bar comes back once you leave clear mode. (#277)
* **Instagram - Clean up Reels:** With `Keep clear mode on`, the buttons, author row and top bar could pop back up a few swipes in while a reel was still in clear mode. They stay hidden now, and come back when clear mode ends. Reported in #233.
* **Instagram - Hide the Explore grid:** Turning on `Hide suggested accounts in search` took your recent searches away too. Now it hides only the Suggested for you accounts. (#272)
* **Instagram - Turn off HDR brightness boosts:** On Instagram's armeabi-v7a builds (for 32-bit phones) the switch now turns off SDR super white and Ultra HDR always on too. Before, only the arm64 build had those two options turned off. (#85)
* **Instagram - HushGram settings:** The settings shortcut on the app icon no longer shows a second of Reels (or whatever tab Instagram opens on) before the settings come up. The screen stays black until they're drawn. (#55)
* **Instagram - Download any video:** Saved reels play with sound in more apps. Some reels carry only xHE-AAC sound, which many players turn silent. When the post also has a plain video file, the save keeps the best picture and takes that file's sound. Refs #242.
* **Instagram - Glass tab bar:** With the pill floating, a reel stops above the pill again, as in 0.0.13, so there's no wide black band over the video. The seek bar stays clear of the pill and the gesture handle. (#280)
* **Instagram - Glass tab bar:** A reel keeps one size while comments, the keyboard and a paused reel's controls come and go, and the glass doesn't draw the reel's video into its blur anymore. Both made a playing reel resize. (#222)
* **Instagram - Glass tab bar:** If the blur ever drops to the plain dark tint while you scroll, it comes back by itself a moment later. Before, it stayed that way until Instagram restarted. (#262)
* **Instagram - Start Home on Following:** Tapping Back to home at the end of your Following feed closed Instagram. Now it switches Home to For you, like picking it from the top menu. With `Only accounts you follow` on, Home just stays on Following.
* **Instagram - Pure black dark mode:** Stories are black around the edges too. The thin strip above a story and the bar behind its reply field kept Instagram's dark gray before. The story itself keeps its colors. (#279)

### Improvements

* **Instagram:** HushGram now patches Instagram 452.1.0.53.64 instead of 452.0.0.48.64. Get APKMirror's (arm64-v8a) (480-640dpi) (Android 9.0+) variant, build 385811006. The armeabi-v7a build (385811005) patches too, and so do the x86 and x86_64 builds (385811007 and 385811008), which Instagram is shipping again.
* **Instagram:** HushGram now builds on Morphe patcher 2.0.0, so update Morphe Manager to 2.0.0 or newer before patching. On a computer, use morphe-desktop 1.19.0 or newer. Patching with every patch on takes about 40% less time there. (#60)
* **Instagram - Find the reel you came from:** Trial reels (shown to people who don't follow the creator) aren't on the creator's profile, so the search could only give up. Tapping the creator of one now shows a short note and skips the search. Reported in #225.
* **Instagram - Download any video:** Skip what's already saved reads its history file in small, fixed amounts now. A damaged file can't slow a save down, and it gets written out fresh at the next save, so newer saves aren't lost behind the damage. (#150)
* **Instagram - Turn off double tap to like:** Patching takes about 4% less time with every patch on. The patch reads code only in the places its targets can be, instead of every method in the app. The patched app comes out the same. Refs #173.
* **Instagram - View stories anonymously:** Patching with every patch on takes about 3% less time and 5% less processor work. Its checks for other callers now read only the classes that can hold one. The patched app doesn't change. Refs #173.
* **Instagram:** HushGram launch screen and Emoji style now ask the patcher's index where their code is, instead of reading every method. With every patch on, that's about 3% less processor work. Same patched app as before. Refs #173.
* **Instagram:** Patches that find their code by a piece of text, or by Instagram's internal labels, now look it up directly instead of checking every string. Patching is about 2% quicker. The patched app is the same. Refs #173.
* **Tooling:** `scripts/native-runner.ps1` runs checks inside the installed patched Instagram on an offline emulator, as a throwaway signed-out Android user. Each verdict names the exact APK it ran on. Two controls (build identity, a missing hook) must hold before feature checks count.
* **Tooling:** The native runner's first feature checks cover Hide your active status. They build Instagram's own presence requests without sending them, and only Active may turn Idle, only while the switch is on and HushGram isn't paused.
* **Tooling:** The native runner checks View DM photos and videos anonymously on Instagram's receipt handler. Switched on, the handler finishes a stand-in receipt on the phone without building its request. Voice receipts, a paused HushGram and the switch off stay Instagram's.
* **Tooling:** Nothing goes public until the whole app has been walked with that exact bundle on a release phone or an emulator. `publish-release.ps1` stops before GitHub without a full, crash-free walk of that bundle.
* **Tooling:** `scripts/find-release-for-identity.ps1` reads the `hg1:` build identity from a diagnostics report and names the release it came from, or says the build isn't one of ours, so a repackaged fork shows up before anyone digs in.

### Validation

Validation: 5910 runtime tests passed locally. All 2051 patch tests passed too.

* **Tooling:** Nothing goes public until the whole app has been walked with that exact bundle on a release phone or an emulator. `publish-release.ps1` stops before GitHub without a full, crash-free walk of that bundle.
* **Tooling:** `scripts/find-release-for-identity.ps1` reads the `hg1:` build identity from a diagnostics report and names the release it came from, or says the build isn't one of ours, so a repackaged fork shows up before anyone digs in.

### Validation

Validation: 5910 runtime tests passed locally. All 2051 patch tests passed too.

hushthreads.body:
HushThreads v0.0.16 has 20 patches for Threads 452.0.0.50.64 (`com.instagram.barcelona`), and it patches that version only. It's built on Morphe patcher 2.0.0, so you need Morphe Manager 2.0.0 or newer. Update Threads to 452 before you patch.

Hide ads now also goes after the ads Threads fetches for the replies under an opened post. There's a new `Disable swipe to Search` patch too, for accounts where a sideways swipe on the feed slides into Search.

**Your reports in this release**

- [#12](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushThreads/issues/12) found ads among the replies when you open a post. Those come with the post rather than through the feed, and Hide ads now empties that list as well.
- [#13](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushThreads/issues/13) asked for a way to stop the feed sliding into Search on a sideways swipe. Turn on `No swipe into Search` on the Feed page and restart Threads. The Search button still works.

## Threads

- HushThreads now patches Threads 452.0.0.50.64 only, the newest stable version, and drops 451.0.0.51.80. Update Threads to 452 before you patch. The bundle is built with Morphe's 2.0 patcher, so you'll need Morphe Manager 2.0.0 or newer.
- Hide ads now also takes out the ads that show up among the replies when you open a post. Threads sends those with the post instead of through your feed, which is how they slipped past before. Turn Hide ads off, or pause HushThreads, and they show the way Threads draws them. The Hide ads switch says so in all six languages.
- New `Disable swipe to Search` patch. On accounts where a sideways swipe on your feed slides into Search, the swipe stops and your feed stays put. The Search button still opens Search. Only some accounts have the swipe, and on the others nothing changes. The `No swipe into Search` switch is on the Feed page of HushThreads settings and starts off. Restart Threads after you flip it.
- A download that runs out of its ten minutes now always says it was too slow. Every so often its last wait ended a fraction of a millisecond early, and you were told the network failed instead.

## Tooling

- A release can't go public until the whole app is walked with that exact bundle on a release phone or an emulator. The publish stage now takes the walk's receipt as `-Walk` and stops before the tag or GitHub if the walk wasn't a full pass, saw a Threads crash, ran on some other device, or patched with a different bundle.
- `scripts/walk-app.ps1` does that walk. It patches Threads from the release bundle and installs it, opens the feed, Search, Activity, a profile and a post by their links, then goes in through the Profile tab, the profile's Settings button and the HushThreads row in Threads' settings and opens every HushThreads settings page. A screen only counts when Threads shows that screen's own view, since a link Threads doesn't handle still opens Threads, on the feed. Any Threads crash or ANR since the walk began fails it, and the receipt it writes is the one publish asks for. Its only taps are those three steps and the settings rows, each checked on its own screen, so it can't follow, block or message anyone, or like a post.

## Update

1. You need [Morphe Manager](https://github.com/MorpheApp/morphe-manager) 2.0.0 or newer. If HushThreads is already one of your patch sources, Manager shows 0.0.16 once it refreshes. If it isn't, add it: https://morphe.software/add-source?github=SysAdminDoc%2FHushThreads
2. Get Threads 452.0.0.50.64 (arm64-v8a, version code 512207626) and patch that. v0.0.15 was the last release for Threads 451.
3. Manager's default selection has every patch except `Change version code`, `Remove share targets` and `Trust user-added certificates`. Turn on Expert mode if you want any of those.
4. Patch with the Morphe Manager signing key you used last time. That's what lets the update install over your patched Threads and keep your data and your login. Coming from the stock Threads, uninstall it first.
5. On a fresh install, sign in with your Instagram username and password.

The `.mpp` download is a patch bundle, not a Threads APK. [Installation instructions](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushThreads#install).

## Validation

1004 runtime tests and 287 patch tests passed locally, along with both Android lints and the release script checks. All 20 patches applied without forcing to Threads 452.0.0.50.64, and the release receipt records the run. The dependency advisory check passed.
